$comment: UVW candidate 1.0 conformance vectors. Accept cases are the shipped fixtures; reject cases are mutations of them in the same vocabulary the other suites use, so a second implementation executes them rather than reading them. Candidate status now means the independent real-game evidence exists but the block 18 scope and release vectors are not frozen.
note: The fixture vectors remain schema-level checks. Separate executable Modkit differentials materialize exact StarCraft II and Warzone 2100 terrain through publisher-qualified live world candidates; block 18 still owns admission and release-vector freeze.

vectors.note: the plain case: one metre-scaled heightfield with a no-data hole
two layers in canonical id order, in source units with no invented metre factor
declaring more rows than the grid carries is refused, not padded: padding invents ground
the cells-versus-samples off-by-one, which otherwise shows up as terrain one cell narrow
absence of ground is noDataValue; a non-finite elevation is a defect
a layer wider than the world it belongs to; the extent is (samples - 1) * cellSize
authoring order is not a property of the world; two converters must emit one document
two layers sharing an id make paging ambiguous, since a page names layers by id
source-unit means nobody measured a metre factor; stating one asserts a measurement that was never made
